title: adaptive-trace-writer: multiplex probe and graceful degrade to Tempo/Jaeger
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: build an adaptive trace writer that can multiplex OTLP span envelopes to primary (Tempo) and secondary (Jaeger) backends, detect backend degradation, and gracefully degrade or fall back while preserving sampling determinism and tenant-level SLAs. This ticket covers design, an initial probe implementation, resilience hooks (circuit-breaker + backpressure), and integration tests with local Tempo/Jaeger test clusters.
comments: 2025-11-12 - Aisha: Created spike ticket. Ran local tempo+jaeger with OTLP-gateway; initial multiplex attempt delivered spans to both backends but observed 2x CPU and 1.8x egress during peak. Need to add conditional fanout and per-tenant priority lanes.

2025-11-13 - Marcus: Spike results attached in PR. Implemented header-preserving fanout. Observed inconsistent span IDs in Jaeger for requests where we applied envelope compression. Root cause: custom compression plugin was mutating traceid endianness. Reverted compression for Jaeger path as temporary mitigation.

2025-11-15 - Marcus: Design decision: introduce a small compatibility shim that normalizes TraceID/SpanID endian and legacy tag mapping for Jaeger path. This avoids changing canonical SDK behavior. Added design doc link.
2025-11-16 - SRE: Runbook drafted for backend failover with steps to toggle 'force-primary-only' at the ingress route. Also recommended a short-circuit for tenant with high error budget.

2025-11-17 - PM (Lena): Prioritize maintaining deterministic sampling between backends to avoid telemetry skew for customer dashboards. Marcus to implement consistent hashing-based sampling key derived from span attributes.

2025-11-18 - Marcus: Implemented simple circuit-breaker and token-bucket backpressure emitter. When Tempo latency > 1200ms for 30s, switch to async buffered write and mark spans with 'backend.fallback=tempo_delayed'. Added metrics: writer.fallback.count and writer.buffer.drain_ms.

2025-11-19 - Reviewer (Diego): Code review notes: prefer non-blocking buffered channel with backpressure metric emission instead of sleeps; add unit tests that simulate partial ack and JAeger schema mismatch. Also request: document compatibility table for which OTLP attributes are rewritten to Jaeger tags.

2025-11-20 - Marcus: Addressed review comments. Pushed updated PR with additional unit tests and an integration harness using docker-compose tempo+jaeger. Next: perf run on staging and add dashboard panels for per-tenant fanout ratio and cross-backend sample consistency.

TODO - post-merge: add e2e test that injects intermittent 5xx from Tempo and validates buffer durability and deterministic sampling across a 24h synthetic workload. Also add an emergency toggle in Console rollout UI for primary-only writes.
